habitat: Deciduous/mixed forests; urban areas; broadleaf/coniferous forest; and wooded parks
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Northen Boobook (Ninox japonica) stands out. This species, part of the Strigidae family, is a resident of Deciduous/mixed forests; urban areas; broadleaf/coniferous forest; and wooded parks. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Northen Boobook is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Northen Boobook and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
